label_rule: fastest deadline-feasible algorithm within 5% of the best observed profit

computation.basis: sum of four independently replayed candidate solver times; reported separately from measured FGR response latency

limitations: Offline counterfactual evaluation uses independent algorithm trajectories, not one causal replay trajectory.
Training and held-out runs share the synthetic topology and seeded traffic generator.
The local FGR executes candidates sequentially, but its stored time is the maximum candidate runtime rather than total CPU work.
BRAIN-topology and live-system generalization remain untested.
